{"metadata":{"description":"The Deepseek Harness ROS 2 plugin can be used to efficiently diagnose issues and perform joint debugging.","id":"gh:1337006925","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-ros2","slug":"StvLi/dsh-ros2","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"The Deepseek Harness ROS 2 plugin can be used to efficiently diagnose issues and perform joint debug"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"eepseek Harness ROS 2 plugin can be used to efficiently diagnose issues and perform joint debugging."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-ros2"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> ROS2 debugging toolset and robot-state vision analysis for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), shipped as a pl"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ugin. 中文版见 README_CN.md."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **版本对应关系**：npm 上的 `dsh-ros2@0.1.0` 就是本仓库当前版本（monorepo 布局）。
> GitHub 的 `v0.8.0 ~ v0.15.0` 标签是已废弃的旧单"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"体布局历史，从未发布到 npm。
> 版本号在 2026-08 monorepo 拆分时重新基线。详见 docs/versioning.md。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**dsh-ros2** gives a DSH agent full robot development / debugging capabilities on any host with ROS2"},{"id":"p5s2","text":", organized in four capability tiers:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Tier | Capability | Safety boundary |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| **L1** | Read-only diagnostics: package/workspace/dependency checks, node/topic/service/action/par"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"am/interface enumeration, one-shot topic sampling, TF tree queries, whole-graph topology JSON, `ros2"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"doctor`, bag summaries, MoveIt discovery, robot-profile load, safety-state read & VLM semantic arbit"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ration | Pure read-only, no approval |
| **L2** | Approval-gated management: `colcon build` (backgro"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"und job), `rosdep install`, message skeleton generation, `param set`, bounded `bag record`, one-clic"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"k ROS2 install, launch management, rosbag replay, MoveIt motion, zero-pose calibration, robot regist"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ration & topology learning, **safety_monitor start / human-gated lock / unlock** | Writes always ask"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" first (fail-closed) |
| **L3** | Visualization: RViz2 / rqt lifecycle management, screenshots, mult"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"imodal vision description, xdotool-level window interaction | Local session operations; interaction "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"is confined to an application allowlist and asks first outside it |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| RViz2 offscreen render (latest `lite_urdf`, real material colors) | Head camera | Wrist-left camer"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"a | Wrist-right camera |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> Left: `rviz_offscreen_node` renders with the real rviz stack (OGRE) and publishes to the `/rviz/sc"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ene` image topic. Right: three frames grabbed from live camera topics by `ros2_image_snapshot` (1280"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"×720). Full test record: `docs/test-robot-state-vision.md`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Zero-intrusion diagnostics**: 83 tools cover most ROS2 debugging scenarios — from "is the packag"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"e installed?" to "what is on this topic right now?", one command, one answer;
- **Whole-graph topolo"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"gy**: `ros2_graph` folds nodes/publishers/subscribers/services/actions into one JSON — see the syste"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"m structure in seconds;
- **Approval-gated writes**: builds, dependency installs, message scaffoldin"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"g etc. go through the DSH approval service; fail-closed, denial = failure;
- **Visualization as a se"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"rvice**: "see" headlessly — screenshots / multimodal description / window interaction are fully loca"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"l, no remote display;
- **Parallel realtime vision**: the VLM runs in a separate ROS2 process (`vlm_"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"node`, service `/vlm/describe`); images come from topics (`sensor_msgs/Image` / `CompressedImage`); "},{"id":"p12s9","text":"`vision_bringup` auto-creates one bridge per image topic, headless-ready;
- **RViz2 offscreen render"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"ing (motion render ~22 Hz on llvmpipe; 30 Hz full rate with GPU)**: the real rviz render kernel (`rv"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"iz_common` + OGRE) renders any `.rviz` scene on a virtual display and publishes it as an image topic"},{"id":"p12s12","text":" — no screenshots, no X11 window-stacking dependency. **Performance optimizations**: open3d low-poly"},{"id":"p12s13","text":" meshes (`scripts/simplify_visual_meshes.py`) + direct OGRE pixel read (no PNG round-trip) + double-"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"render elimination → motion rendering 1.9 → ~22 Hz on llvmpipe (11×), and **30 Hz full rate with NVI"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"DIA GPU passthrough** (v0.9.3), memory −2.5×;
- **Real-time safety framework** (`safety_monitor` nod"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"e + `robot_safety_*` tools, see Safety framework): layered defense — tool-layer safety gate (pre-exe"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"cution `/safety/state` check) → reactive monitors (motion tracking/stall with hysteresis, joint-feed"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"back loss, watchdog, optional torque) → event-driven VLM semantic arbitration → human arbitration. L"},{"id":"p12s19","text":"atched `NORMAL`/`LOCKED` state machine (lock persists until a human unlocks; non-fatal events never "},{"id":"p12s20","text":"lock); every threshold/topic/lock-action is registered per robot in the profile `safety` section; th"},{"id":"p12s21","text":"e geometric pre-check (joint limits / velocity / FK self-collision) is a reserved layer;
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- A host with ROS2 (**Jazzy** verified; Humble should work), `ros2` on `PATH`;
- Node `^22.19 || >=2"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"4` (DSH host requirement);
- L4 vision additionally needs Python 3 `rclpy` and an OpenAI-compatible "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"VLM gateway (e.g. Gemini or a self-hosted gateway)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Install the plugins (9 npm packages, since the monorepo split)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Install the domain bundles you need — or the **`dsh-ros2` aggregate**, which
mounts core/profile/mov"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"eit/safety/vision (81 tools + the 9 skills). Add the
optional `dsh-ros2-state` for the family's full"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" 83 tools. All packages are
published to npm at **0.1.0** (see docs/versioning.md for
the GitHub ↔ n"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"pm version correspondence)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Via the DSH plugin CLI** (recommended; resolves through npm):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Via npm directly** (same packages; useful for inspecting/installing the
optional add-ons):"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> Package roles: `dsh-ros2` (aggregate) · `dsh-ros2-common` (shared library) ·
> `dsh-ros2-core` (co"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"re diagnostics) · `dsh-ros2-profile` (profiles/topology) ·
> `dsh-ros2-moveit` (MoveIt motion) · `ds"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"h-ros2-safety` (safety framework) ·
> `dsh-ros2-vision` (vision pipeline) · `dsh-ros2-state` (state "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"client) ·
> `dsh-ros2-sidecar` (data-plane daemon)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"> **Prompt guidance.** `dsh-ros2-core` contributes a system-prompt section that
> points the model a"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"t this toolchain for ROS2 work — discover the graph with

> `moveit_*`/`robot_safety_*` (approval-gated, gated on `/sa"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"fety/state`) — instead

> core therefore carries it, the `dsh-ros2` aggregate included.
>
> The section is rebuilt on "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"every assembly from the tools that are registered at
> that moment, so a core-only install is never "},{"id":"p23s7","text":"told to call `moveit_move` or
